Donor: hsoliwal/com.synexia develop 5ecfe052562cdd1a7a6570068654c7f813fd0f47 (2026-11-06, "Merge pull request #16754"), the one pin of the three pmem follow-up leaves (source image, task log/replay, gram index). It is after #16749 (36827ee8a798: NativePmem adb94eb2f091 and PmemSourceImage bd2c6c1ee83e with verifySealed, the pr16669 head copies) and after #16750 (merge 061f544acfc8, PR head d0094f81f4cf: re-sealed PmemTransferRecipe and PmemSourceSlicesRecipe; git diff 36827ee8a798..5ecfe052562c touches m3-pmem-sdk/recipes only, so every region-core row of recipe/pmem-region-core-20261106 holds the same blob at this pin). Every FILE row but PmemSourceImage (BLOB row) is develop's own blob (PROVENANCE base_kind DEVELOP).

# Lineage of PmemSourceImage: develop 3e8244bddee (the superset alignment, blob 0db864e19fb6) wired PmemSourcePathIndex into fileIndexOf (7839449e7be 2026-11-02 bounded source-path hash index, 5ff72bcc0fe probe bound) but had no verifySealed; #16749 (faf902e3a308) replaced the file by the pr16669 head copy bd2c6c1ee83e = the streaming-seal POST (3ba80841, crate m3-pmem-streaming-seal-20261105) plus readSealed(int,byte[],int) (e2223951f8d), whose fileIndexOf is the plain Arrays.binarySearch. No develop commit held both at that pin, so the relocated M3PmemSourceImage is develop's blob and M3PmemSourcePathIndex (census L026) is relocated with its oracle and the probe-bound proof lane of the differential but had no caller there; the wiring is restored by the donor fix-forward com.synexia #16762 (crate m3-pmem-source-path-wiring-20261106, blob 743e5bb54bc6 at 9b4728b743ab), pinned by the BLOB row of PmemSourceImage (PROVENANCE base_kind PR_HEAD_SUPERSET); M3PmemSourcePathIndex is called by M3PmemSourceImage again.

# FILE rows: donor path -> target path (module root m3/optane). VERBATIM rows (v3): exact donor bytes under an evidence/ directory (donor-run logs, hash tables, input manifests and preimage records whose statements name donor paths and digests). PACKAGE/TYPE/EXTERNAL/TEXT rows as in recipe/pmem-region-core-20261106; the TYPE rows of that leaf are repeated because the relocated files name its types. SKIP/DROP rows document what is not relocated.
